svg.title: W2-02 Five Dyad Transformations (instructor)
svg.desc: Five panels, each starting from C4 and E4. Case 1 upper E to F gives C4 and F4, a perfect fourth, oblique. Case 2 lower C to B3 gives B3 and E4, a perfect fourth, oblique. Case 3 lower C to D gives D4 and E4, a major second, oblique. Case 4 contrary C to B3 and E to F gives B3 and F4, a tritone. Case 5 similar C to D and E to F gives D4 and F4, a minor third.

g.text: Case 1: Upper voice E→F, lower holds C
Case 2: Lower voice C→B, upper holds E
Case 3: Lower voice C→D, upper holds E
Every case starts from C4 + E4.

svg.text: Registers matter: the note below C4 is B3, not B4. Distance on the page is not a feeling; it is a count of semitones.
Original AMF graphic, rendered from data (no AI-drawn notation). C4 = MIDI 60.
